items.title: AI-generated music surpasses 50% of daily uploads on Deezer
items.excerpt: Deezer says fully AI-generated tracks now make up more than 50% of new daily uploads, averaging ~90,000 AI songs a day in June, and is moving to flag and de-monetise them. A signal of how fast generative-music tools like Suno and Udio are flooding streaming catalogues and forcing platform-side detection.

items.title: Major labels call for AI 'slop' songs to be banned from entering charts around the world
items.excerpt: Sony, Universal and Warner are pushing to disqualify fully AI-generated 'slop' tracks from global charts as tens of thousands of AI songs hit streaming daily, alongside an RIAA/IFPI proposal to label fully- or partly-AI songs in streaming apps. Frames the emerging rules of the road for AI-made music and how disclosure may shape creative practice.

items.title: 'Human-First' is a promise nobody can check yet
items.excerpt: As 'Human-First' and AI-disclosure labels proliferate across music, this argues they mean little without enforcement, proposing distributor-enforced, open-source-style attestations covering composition, performance, vocals and production. A craft-side look at how AI-use disclosure could actually work for the people making the music.

items.title: Only humans can be 'authors', say Canadian music publishers in AI copyright test case
items.excerpt: Music Publishers Canada has intervened in a court case testing whether AI-generated works qualify for copyright and whether an AI tool can be named a co-author, arguing 'only a human can be an author'. Directly shapes how music creators can claim, protect and credit work made with generative tools.

items.title: AudioAuditor is a free, open-source audio toolkit with built-in AI music detection
items.excerpt: AudioAuditor is a free, open-source desktop/CLI player and audio-analysis toolkit that also tries to flag AI-generated music by inspecting watermarks and byte patterns (with the devs candid that detection is still unreliable). A hands-on tool letting producers and listeners probe whether a track was machine-made.
